prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Hospital medication dispensing/returns require pharmacist authorization/traceability. Aliases: Medication Order Gateway=Morrowglass; Pharmacy Technician=Copperfield; Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot=Cinderwake; Pharmacy Verification Station=Juniper; Sensor-monitored Medication Cooler=Bluejay; Registered Nurse=Larkspur; Medication Return Kiosk=Tallowmere; Biomedical Engineer=Stonewake. Morrowglass validates/timestamps orders, routes discrepancies/status, produces Order Reconciliation Snapshot; unresolved/canceled/duplicated/superseded orders stay held. Clinical Pharmacist documents clinical/dose/allergy/interaction/labeling/temperature/timing disposition before release; produces Dose Exception Review Slip. Copperfield checks identifiers/contents/packaging/lot/expiry/cold-chain, escalates, produces Cold Chain Handoff Card. Cinderwake prepares authorized orders, records handling, produces Priority Refill Tote Tag, presents packages to Juniper. Juniper verifies order/medication/destination, blocks incomplete release, produces Batch Release Note linking identifiers/time/credentials. Bluejay continuously records timestamped temperatures, displays current temperature/excursions, reports excursions/connectivity loss; affected stock segregated pending authorized disposition. Cold packages remain controlled until custody transfer. Hospital Courier checks count/integrity/destination/handling, records custody/time/identity, secures capsule, produces Pneumatic Capsule Seal Record. Pneumatic Tube Network reconciles identifiers/destination against prepared load before admission. Manifest records packages/destinations/handling/assembly-time; identifier checks detect omissions/substitutions/duplicates. Packaging/route problems hold loads pending documented resolution; unavailable automation requires retained custody/approved alternate delivery. East Tube Dispatch Console records availability/route/timing/status, sends Tube Route Exception Ticket; West Tube Dispatch Console controls authorized routing. Copperfield rechecks retries; faulted segments require testing/authorization. Receiving department reports arrival/discrepancies. Ward staff verify ward, identifiers/legibility/task-list, quantity/descriptions/receipt-record, packaging integrity; Larkspur checks refrigerated handling. North Ward Cabinet Controller/South Ward Cabinet Controller record arrival-time/destination-cabinet; North uses Priority Refill Tote Tag. Mismatches isolated, never stocked unresolved; accepted medication staged pending placement authorization; receipt/discrepancies recorded. Return bins require intact/clean/correct-stream, secure unobstructed closure; Larkspur verifies eligibility/waste separation. Tallowmere records checks; Copperfield identifies collection bins using audit label. Charge Nurse sends Cabinet Downtime Notice; controllers block Out of Service dispensing until

New part:
S118: Staff reconcile the bin contents with the return entry before the bin is closed.
S119: Questionable or damaged returned medication is segregated and referred for review rather than combined with accepted returns.
S120: A checked return bin remains secured in its designated holding location until collection is authorized.
S121: The Hospital Courier collects only bins that are closed and recorded as ready for collection.
S122: The Charge Nurse ensures that unresolved receipt or return discrepancies remain assigned for follow-up at shift handover.
S123: A dose exception is any mismatch, omission, duplicate request, or clinically implausible value detected before a medication is released for use.
S124: The affected transaction remains on hold until an authorized reviewer documents a disposition.
S125: The Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot stops the affected pick sequence and keeps the package in a controlled hold location pending review.
S126: Cinderwake preserves the scanned product and quantity data associated with the exception.
S127: Juniper compares the active order with the scanned product, strength, and measured quantity, and blocks verification when a field differs.
S128: Pharmacy Verification Station uses the review slip to record the exception category, evidence checked, disposition, and reviewer identity.
S129: The Clinical Pharmacist assesses dose, route, timing, and patient-specific clinical concerns before approving a correction or rejecting the order.
S130: A correction requires a valid authorized order and must not be inferred from prior dispensing history.
S131: Larkspur keeps the cabinet transaction locked and confirms that the medication has not been administered while review is pending.
S132: The Registered Nurse escalates an urgent patient-care concern to the Clinical Pharmacist and follows the hospital's clinical response procedure.
S133: The Registered Nurse does not bypass a hold or substitute a product to clear an exception.
S134: The Charge Nurse assigns unresolved exceptions to a named role and confirms that ownership is maintained at shift handover.
S135: The Pharmacy Technician may gather package and transaction evidence but may not make a clinical dose decision.
S136: The Medication Order Gateway rejects incomplete or internally inconsistent order updates and retains the rejection reason for review.
S137: The North Ward Cabinet Controller prevents access to a held transaction until an authorized disposition is recorded.
S138: The South Ward Cabinet Controller reports a failed lock or an unrecognized access attempt for immediate operational review.
S139: The Sensor-monitored Medication Cooler reports excursions that could affect medication suitability, and affected stock remains unavailable pending assessment.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
